categories.main_business_segments: Okumura Corporation operates primarily in three business segments: Civil Engineering, Building Construction, and Investment Development. The Civil Engineering and Building Construction segments cover a wide range of public and private construction projects, while the Investment Development segment focuses on real estate sales and leasing, as well as renewable energy power generation and sales. The group also engages in related businesses such as construction consulting, manufacturing and sales of construction materials, and PFI (Private Finance Initiative) projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced construction technologies, including precast PC slab joint methods (Z Spiral®), automated concrete placement systems for tunnel linings, and environmental remediation technologies for PFAS contamination. In building construction, it develops seismic isolation technologies (VOD® oil dampers) and efficient steel foundation beam methods. The group also invests in digital transformation (DX), ICT-based productivity improvements, and energy-efficient construction methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Okumura serves both public sector clients (government agencies, municipalities) and private sector customers (real estate developers, logistics, manufacturing, and commercial facility operators). Major end markets include infrastructure (railways, highways), logistics facilities, hospitals, commercial buildings, and renewable energy projects. No single customer accounts for more than 10% of total sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Japan, with a nationwide network of branches and subsidiaries. While the vast majority of sales and assets are domestic, Okumura also undertakes select overseas projects, particularly in Asia (e.g., Taiwan). Over 90% of revenue and assets are based in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Okumura operates as a downstream player in the construction and real estate value chain, acting as a general contractor and project developer. It also participates in the midstream through the manufacturing and supply of construction materials and equipment via subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the core construction business, expanding into non-construction revenue streams (real estate, renewable energy), and enhancing corporate value through innovation and sustainability. R&D focuses on productivity improvements (DX, automation), environmental technologies (decarbonization, resource recycling), and workplace well-being. The company has set clear ESG/SDGs targets and is investing in human capital and diversity.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through construction contract work (project-based billing), real estate sales and leasing, and electricity sales from renewable energy. Additional income streams include consulting, equipment manufacturing, and PFI project operations. Revenue recognition is based on the progress of construction projects and delivery of services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Okumura is positioned as a mid-tier general contractor in Japan, competing with major construction firms such as Kajima, Obayashi, Shimizu, and Taisei, as well as regional and specialized contractors. The company differentiates itself through technical expertise, reliability, and a balanced portfolio of civil, building, and development projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥298.2 billion, with operating profit of ¥9.7 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥2.7 billion. The company employs approximately 2,500 people. While sales have shown steady growth, profitability declined significantly in FY2025 due to large project losses and a major impairment in the renewable energy business. The company maintains a strong equity ratio (45.1%) but is currently in a phase of profit recovery.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Okumura emphasizes 'reliable management and sincere construction' as its core value, aiming to deliver high-quality, safe, and sustainable infrastructure and buildings. The company differentiates itself through advanced construction technologies, a strong track record in both public and private sectors, and a commitment to ESG and stakeholder trust. Its integrated approach to construction, development, and innovation supports long-term societal and environmental value.
